sources.entry: MenuTube - Catch YouTube into your macOS menu bar!

summary.one_liner: MenuTube is a macOS menu bar app that puts the YouTube website into a small window so you can listen to or watch content without a full browser tab.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes MenuTube as a way to place the full YouTube website in the macOS menu bar, aimed at podcasts, audiobooks, interviews and other content that does not need video focus. It states that it browses the mobile YouTube version. It supports controlling media playback with the keyboard's media keys. The README calls the UI intuitive and simple, and mentions "and more" features without listing them. Build instructions use npm to produce a macOS application, and a dev mode is available via npm start.
use_cases: listen to YouTube podcasts from the menu bar
play audiobooks or interviews from YouTube in the background
control YouTube playback with keyboard media keys
keep YouTube out of a full browser tab on a Mac
notable: Runs the YouTube website in the macOS menu bar
Media key support for playback control
Build to a macOS app via npm run dist
caveats: README names only macOS (darwin) as the build target
README does not list the specific features beyond the bullet points, and gives no detail on the underlying framework
Download link is referenced but no release details are given in the README
